title: Hachimitsu to Clover Specials
justification: AniList 644 (SPECIAL, 2 episode(s) from 2005-12-23) is AniDB 2835's special(s) S1-S2, aired 2005-12-23 to 2006-02-24. AniList's PARENT relation names the parent entry, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 2835. The parent node has no mapping rows, so S1-S2 default to TVDB 0x1-0x2.
